question: Are the rejected admission trial losses missing pitches or changed string assignments, and which added false outputs coincide with causal cues?

scope.bulk_inputs: Retained report and text evidence archives consumed only by GitHub Actions; no laptop download.

acceptance: Both archive digests and selected member digests match the recorded admission screen.
Reproduce all 499 current/trial exact label holds and each output-safety voice-sample count.
Attribute target recovery and losses to pitch absence versus exact string assignment, preserving gross gains and losses.
Associate added false spans with only preceding cue evidence; do not infer a native branch from timing alone.
limitations: Saved output establishes delivered offline pitches and lanes, not why the joint assignment changed.
No new detector, audio, timing, allocation, buffer or host measurement.
next_step: Use the retained comparison to choose the smallest replacement admission or assignment condition. Require target recovery with no passage or false-output regression before any corpus or host work.
